seo.title: About ISTAM
seo.description: A Consulting and Training organization accredited by the State under N°1967, ISTAM has supported companies and organizations in their pursuit of performance since 2006.

hero.title: ISTAM — Consulting and professional training
hero.description: A Consulting and Training organization accredited by the State under N°1967, ISTAM has supported companies and organizations in their pursuit of performance and operational excellence since 2006.

intro.title: Consulting, project management and training in the service of performance
intro.paragraph1: Founded in 2006, ISTAM supports companies and organizations in their pursuit of performance and operational excellence, through three complementary areas of expertise: strategy consulting, dedicated to organizational optimization and sustainable business development; project management (PMO/PMA), with solid experience across ERP environments; and continuing professional training.
intro.paragraph2: Our training programs cover leadership, management, project management and soft-skills development, delivered by a team of permanent staff and a wide network of expert consultants who design consulting and training programs tailored to each professional project.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.description: Enable individuals and organizations to reveal their full potential, by cultivating a dynamic of continuous learning and progress.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.description: Train the next generation of leaders, through comprehensive, tailor-made development programs.

values.title: Integrity • Knowledge • Transformation • Ambition • Mastery
values.description: Five principles that spell out ISTAM and guide everything we do.

integrity.title: Integrity
integrity.description: We act with honesty, ethics and transparency in all our relationships. "Trust is the foundation of our success."

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.description: We believe knowledge is the primary lever for transforming individuals and organizations. "Learning today to succeed tomorrow."

transformation.title: Transformation
transformation.description: We build skills that produce concrete, lasting results. "Turning knowledge into performance."

ambition.title: Ambition
ambition.description: We encourage everyone to aim for excellence and push past their limits. "Dare, progress and succeed."

mastery.title: Mastery
mastery.description: We pursue excellence in our training, our methods and our interventions. "Expertise in the service of performance."

approach.title: A method grounded in the field
approach.description: We co-build every engagement with your teams, taking into account your organization's culture and specific realities. From initial diagnosis to implementation, we apply a rigorous methodology that combines strategic consulting, project management and skills development.

diagnose.title: Diagnose
diagnose.description: Understand your teams' real needs before designing the program.

design.title: Design
design.description: Build a learning pathway suited to participants' level and objectives.

deliver.title: Deliver
deliver.description: Deliver the training with hands-on scenarios and a trainer who is an expert in the subject.

followUp.title: Follow up
followUp.description: Measure progress and support the application of new skills over time.

figures.title: A structure built to serve our clients

cta.title: Want to know more about our training programs?
cta.description: Our advisors are here to help you find the program best suited to your goals.
